summary: Solid test suite with good coverage of core functionality (glob matching, rule parsing, priority conflicts, error handling, workflow structure). Unit tests in label-assigner.bats are well-organized by TDD cycles; workflow.bats validates YAML structure and actionlint. End-to-end test via run-act-tests.sh ensures GitHub Actions integration works. Gaps: fixture files (basic.rules, basic-files.txt, priority.rules, priority-files.txt) are referenced but not shown—their contents must be inferred from expected outputs; some whitespace/label-parsing edge cases lack explicit tests; error assertions use loose pattern matching instead of exact message validation. The workflow.bats tests that verify 'ci/labels.rules' and 'ci/changed-files.txt' exist assume fixture files are pre-populated, which could fail if run before act-tests populate them. Would catch most regressions in core logic but risks fixture-dependency failures.
